model_role: RESEARCH ground PANEL detector experiments (0=panel 1=cracked 2=dusty). NOT production. NOT a condition model. Does not replace weights/yolo_solar.pt or weights/yolo_solar_ground_research_v1.pt.

candidate.scene_analysis: ONE ground-mounted installation, ONE capture session (2024-04-30, ~4 min). 2 video sequences (405 frames) + 96 burst-photo events. Independent physical scenes ~= 1.
candidate.native_aspect: 526 portrait / 37 landscape / 0 square (aspect 0.573-1.81) - FIRST non-square ground-level PV panel data we hold
candidate.selection: drop 58 empty-label images; keep every 12th video frame + 1 image per burst timestamp; cap 130; ALL -> train split (1 scene)

derived_dataset: datasets/ground_pv_research/yolo_beast_v1/ (Susan 6,492 immutable + 125 candidate frames; data_A = Susan only, data_BC = Susan train + candidate train, Susan valid/test)

experiments.B: Susan + 125 scene-capped candidate (train only), YOLO11n, imgsz 640, 90 epochs, patience 20, batch 16, v1 conservative aug
experiments.C: Susan + candidate (train only), YOLO11n, imgsz 640, 90 epochs, patience 20, batch 16, moderate scale/aspect aug (scale 0.5, translate 0.15, degrees 7, mosaic 0.4, close_mosaic 15) - NO multi_scale
experiments.A: NOT trained on Kaggle - Susan-only baseline done by re-evaluating the existing v1 checkpoint locally on the identical Susan test set

frozen_across_ABC: Susan valid/test identical -> fair held-out comparison
model_selection_rule: NOT highest mAP. Hierarchy: (1) no catastrophic real-world regression (2) better real-world panel localization on the 6 owner photos (3) better held-out test (4) better recall w/o unacceptable FPs (5) better mAP50-95 (6) reasonable cost. A model that improves test mAP but fails the OOD holdout like v2 -> REJECT.
owner_photos: NOT training data. NOT pseudo-labelled. NOT in validation. NOT used for threshold tuning. Qualitative OOD holdout only.
v1_run_note: v1 of the notebook (3 experiments A/B/C + 27-pass threshold sweep) HUNG on Kaggle GPU for >17h with no output. Over-scoped for one session. Cancelled by pushing v2.
threshold_sweep: done locally on the downloaded checkpoints (Susan val), not in the notebook
